name: Young jackfruit salad
summary: Boiled young jackfruit mixed with pork and shrimp, sweet-sour fish sauce, herbs, and sesame. One account also adds chicken.
origin: Củ Chi. Người Lao Động says jackfruit orchards here fruit through the year, and that this salad is eaten most in this district among southern versions.
howToEat: Boil young jackfruit and mix it with pork and shrimp, or with chicken on one account. Sweet-sour fish sauce, herbs, cilantro, and sesame come with it. Eat it with rice, or as a plate with drinks.
The hour is Check on arrival.
